meta.name: board-prep
meta.description: Board meeting preparation for the adversarial scenario, not the friendly one. Forces numbers-cold mastery, anticipates hard questions, builds a narrative that acknowledges weakness without losing the room. Use when preparing for a board meeting, an investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review where every number must live in your head not just on a slide.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 准备董事会汇报材料，预判尖锐提问
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在高压力场景下向董事会或投资人做数据汇报
copy.tagline_en: Prepare board materials and anticipate tough questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present data to a board or investors under high pressure

howto.what: 它会要求你把所有关键数字(收入、烧钱率、留存等)记到烂熟,预演董事会最刁钻的提问,并按“现状-教训-错误-对策-需求”组织汇报,承认不足但不失掌控。
howto.when: 准备董事会会议、投资人更新、融资演示,或任何高压质询场景时;也可直接输入 /em:board-prep <议程> 启动。

say.text: /em:board-prep 下季度董事会,重点是收入未达标和现金跑道
say.note: 会生成针对这两个痛点的刁钻问题和汇报框架。

say.text: 模拟一个最难缠的董事,拿我的数据逐条追问
say.note: 它会扮演对立角色,并标出让你卡壳的问题。

say.text: 按董事类型准备:运营型、财务型、战略型各关心什么
say.note: 输出每位董事的关注点和风险提示。

howto.what_en: Drills key numbers (revenue, burn, retention) until you know them cold, rehearses the harshest board questions, and shapes a narrative that names weaknesses without losing credibility.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you prepare a board meeting, investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review, or when you run /em:board-prep <agenda>.

say_en.text: /em:board-prep next board meeting, focus on revenue miss and cash runway
say_en.note: Generates tough Q&A and a narrative framework on those pain points.

say_en.text: Simulate the toughest director and grill me on my data line by line
say_en.note: It plays devil's advocate and flags the questions where you hesitated.

say_en.text: Prep by director type: operator, financial, strategic — what each cares about
say_en.note: Outputs each director's concerns and risk signals.
